resources.string: The token of this device from scripts/new-token.sh of your TraFF server. It is sent only to the server address above, only over https:// (http:// only in the local network) and never to the built-in public service. Leave empty to delete the stored token.
Enter the address of your own traffic server first (https://…)
Access token removed: it belongs to the previous server. Enter the token for the new server again.
